success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant retrieves the balance for the checking account using get_account_balance and tells the user the balance.

persona.name: David Kwan
persona.bio: David Kwan invests in cybersecurity and telecommunications startups across the US and Canada. He evaluates pitch decks, conducts due diligence on technical teams, and sits on three portfolio company boards. His days are packed with founder meetings, investor calls, and industry conference panels on 5G infrastructure security.

book me on a flight to new york next monday, returning friday evening
need a private room at a nice restaurant for investor dinner on tuesday, party of 8

messages.output_raw: need to check my bank account balance for my checking account
